name: hotel-hub-engine
description: Commercial-Grade Digital Menu, Booking Engine & Guest Support Infrastructure

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); fs.readdirSync('clients').forEach(f => { if(f.endsWith('.json')) execSync('node src/builder.js clients/' + f, {stdio:'inherit'}); })"
scripts.build:all: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); fs.readdirSync('clients').forEach(f => { if(f.endsWith('.json')) execSync('node src/builder.js clients/' + f, {stdio:'inherit'}); })"
scripts.export: echo '[SUCCESS] Client packages exported to dist/'
